Food technology teachers should be aware of egg-allergic students to allow them to use egg-free recipes and thus avoid reactions.119

#### 12.3 | MMR vaccine

#### 14 | PSYCHOLOGICAL AND SOCIAL IMPLICATIONS OF EGG ALLERGY

All children with egg allergy should receive their normal childhood immunizations, including the MMR, as a routine procedure in primary care.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0217
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: No extra precautions are required.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0218
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text:
Case series of large numbers of egg-allergic children show that there is no increased risk of severe allergic reactions to the MMR vaccine.96,113,114

#### 12.4 | Rabies vaccine

Rabies is a serious viral infection with a high case fatality rate.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0219
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: Rabies vaccines are used as protection before travel to rabies endemic areas, and for post-exposure prophylaxis following the bite of an infected animal.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0220
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: There are two vaccines available, a human diploid cell vaccine that does not contain egg and Purified Chick Embryo Cell (PCEC) vaccine that contains traces of egg protein, including ovalbumin.115 There have been reports of allergic reaction and anaphylaxis to PCEC, some of which may have been related to egg allergy.116 PCEC (Rabipur, GlaxoSmithKline) is relatively contraindicated in individuals with a history of previous egg anaphylaxis.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0221
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: The contra-indication is relative, as rabies is almost universally fatal and immunization for post-exposure prophylaxis outweighs the risk of allergic reaction to the vaccine (Chapter 27, Green Book 2019).
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0222
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: Human Rabies Immunoglobulin (HRIG), a passive immunization used for treatment, does not contain egg protein.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0223
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text:
#### 13 | MANAGEMENT OF EGG ALLERGY IN NURSERIES AND SCHOOLS

Nurseries and schools should have a local policy that covers the management of any food allergy, including egg allergy,117,118 This includes training in allergen avoidance, food labelling regulations30 and knowledge of which foods might contain egg allergens.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0224
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: Training should also include early recognition of symptoms, knowledge of what medication is needed, where it is stored and how it is administered.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0225
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: Children with an egg allergy should have a tailored care plan in place, with adaptions made to the school/nursery meals to enable the child to eat a similar meal or packed lunch sitting alongside their peers.119 School trips may require a separate risk assessment.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0226
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text:
Additional consideration should be given to factors, such as food sharing, food contamination and the provision of ‘treat’ foods,

Any food allergy may adversely affect quality of life, resulting in anxiety and depression.120–122 The constant vigilance needed to avoid egg impacts all aspects of the child's life and that of their family.123,124 The patient may experience anxiety in relation to eating a restricted diet, food avoidance and having allergic reactions.125,126 Children with disabilities, communication disorders and hospitalrelated anxiety may find home introduction, with dietetic guidance and support, less stressful.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0227
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: Children can experience post-traumatic stress following severe allergic reactions.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0228
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text:
This may become a particular problem where egg allergy persists into adolescence.127 Parental coping is critical in the child's risk perception of allergy, anxiety and coping over time.128,129

Psychological help and intervention is effective130–132 in addressing anxiety, phobias and promoting adaptive coping strategies.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0229
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: This can be accessed via paediatric psychology services or CAMHS for children and Improving Access to Psychological Therapies (IAPT) for adults.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0230
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: Patients with mild-moderate egg allergy do not usually require additional psychological support.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0231
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text:
#### 15 | PRIMARY PREVENTION; INTRODUCTION OF EGG INTO THE DIET OF INFANTS FROM ATOPIC FAMILIES

Delayed introduction of allergenic foods to the weaning diet increases the risk of food allergy.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0232
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: Conversely, an earlier and focused allergen introduction schedule can be protective.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0233
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: There is some indication that the early introduction of egg into the infant diet reduces the incidence of egg allergy.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0234
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: Intervention studies show mixed results.133–136 In a meta-analysis,137 the introduction of egg between 4 and 6 months of age reduced the risk of developing egg allergy.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0235
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: Current UK guidance on the introduction of complementary foods is underpinned by WHO advice and recommends exclusive breastfeeding until around 6 months of age with solids started around this age.6 The current UK weaning guidance states that withholding allergenic foods may increase the risk of allergy and that complementary feeding, including egg and peanut, should be introduced, in an age-appropriate form, from around 6 months of age.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0236
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text:
The BSACI recommends earlier introduction of egg into the diet of children with eczema, to reduce the risk of developing allergy.78 Infants with eczema are at higher risk of developing egg allergy and

13652222,2021,10,Downloadedfromhttps://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/cea.14009bySpanishCochraneNationalProvision(MinisteriodeSanidad),WileyOnlineLibraryon[31/10/2025].SeetheTermsandConditions(https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/terms-and-conditions)onWileyOnlineLibraryforrulesofuse;OAarticlesaregovernedbytheapplicableCreativeCommonsLicense

should be encouraged to start weaning between 4 and 6 months once they show signs of readiness.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0237
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text: Egg should be introduced as an early weaning food, after initially establishing an intake of more traditional early weaning foods.8,78 Well-cooked egg starting with a small amount (1 teaspoon) initially, moving upwards towards a full dose.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0238
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text:
Families should be encouraged not to delay egg introduction in the hope of preventing an allergy.138

Studies on early egg introduction have noted that a high proportion of infants are already sensitized to egg protein (positive skin prick test or specific IgE) before weaning and some have clinical egg allergy.133,134,139 Infants with moderate-severe or early onset eczema or existing food allergy are at highest risk of reacting on initial egg introduction, so the first couple of ingestions of baked egg in these groups should be in tiny (pea-sized) amounts.
chunks.chunk_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy_chunk_0239
chunks.doc_id: GUIDELINE - Leech et al. - 2021 - BSACI 2021 guideline for the management of egg allergy

chunks.text:
The risk of severe reactions in these higher risk babies is low but present.78 Egg-specific IgE has a poor predictive value for the development of egg allergy in high-risk infants in the absence of a history of egg ingestion and should not be used in this context.140

#### 16 | FUTURE RESEARCH
